answer: Two independent panels grade the same answer, and when their scores diverge by more than one point the quorum slashes the submitter's stake instead of averaging; any attempt to link two identities resets both records to zero. Because every claim is re-checked by a reviewer with nothing to gain, a farm must keep each clone reproducible under two separate readings. On a terrace of five hundred accounts that is a thousand reads, and the delta between paying for them and earning from them closes. A glacier of clones moves slower than its own bill.
